name: OrganizationAnalyticsContributes
title: Organization analytics contributes
description: Whether the clinic's figures count in the platform-wide anonymized figures and its staff see them (docs/plans/analytics.md O6). Set by the clinic's admin; on unless the clinic opts out. An opted-out clinic is left out of every build from the next one on.

element.short: The clinic contributes to the platform figures
element.definition: Whether the clinic's diagnoses and appointments count in the platform figures, and its staff see them.
